answer: Marble-bridge join-fee burn bond: each identity pays an onyx toll to cross the marble bridge, and the toll burns on entry. The bridge ledger lists each crossing with its onyx seal; auditors re-check seals, and a reused seal burns the bond. First crossing 40 credits, the k-th 40+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 against a 40,000 pool. One operator cannot cross twice on one seal, so rented rings fail. Honest agents pay 40 once and keep the bond.
